gloss: old school building; former school building

definitions.gloss: old school building; former school building
definitions.explanation: A school building that has been replaced by a newer one or that is no longer in active use as a school. May still stand as a historical structure, community facility, or demolition candidate.

examples.japanese: {旧校舎|きゅうこうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}り{壊|こわ}される→取り壊す：15755_torikowasu⟧ことになった。
examples.english: The old school building is going to be demolished.

examples.japanese: {旧校舎|きゅうこうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改装|かいそう}→改装：09682_kaisou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦カフェ→カフェ：06767_kafe⟧にした。
examples.english: They renovated the old school building and turned it into a café.

examples.japanese: ⟦{廃校|はいこう}→廃校：12548_haikou⟧になった{旧校舎|きゅうこうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交流|こうりゅう}→交流：02732_kouryuu⟧⟦センター→センター：03854_sentaa⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}する→活用する：21424_katsuyousuru⟧⟦{動|うご}き→動き：11926_ugoki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: A trend of repurposing closed old school buildings as community exchange centers is spreading nationwide.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{旧|きゅう}→旧：19346_kyuu⟧ (former; old) and ⟦{校舎|こうしゃ}→校舎：02801_kousha⟧ (school building). The prefix ⟦{旧|きゅう}→旧：19346_kyuu⟧~ is productive for indicating former versions of things (⟦{旧|きゅう}→旧：19346_kyuu⟧⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧, former address; ⟦{旧|きゅう}{姓|せい}→旧姓：12957_kyuusei⟧, maiden name). With Japan's declining birth rate causing school closures, repurposing {旧校舎|きゅうこうしゃ} has become a significant topic in regional revitalization.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {旧校舎|きゅうこうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解体|かいたい}→解体：06223_kaitai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to demolish the old school building
- {旧校舎|きゅうこうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活用|かつよう}する→活用する：21424_katsuyousuru⟧: to repurpose the old school building
- {旧校舎|きゅうこうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧: preservation of the old school building
- {旧校舎|きゅうこうしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{跡地|あとち}→跡地：14281_atochi⟧: site of the former school building

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新校舎|しんこうしゃ}: new school building
- ⟦{廃校|はいこう}→廃校：12548_haikou⟧: closed/abandoned school
- ⟦{校舎|こうしゃ}→校舎：02801_kousha⟧: school building (without the old/new distinction)
